# Local Report Export PRD

## Purpose

Help analysts take a durable copy of a report without sending report data to a hosted service.

## Desired outcome

Analysts can export a report and open the result in ordinary spreadsheet software.

## Requirements

- The report page provides a CSV export.
- Export remains entirely local to the user's machine.
- CSV output uses UTF-8 encoding.

## Open question

The product owner has not decided whether nested table values should be flattened or serialized.
